scope: same paired cohort, reference versions, labels, horizons and origins as date_12_paired; no new RQ/outcome/cohort
importance: drop-column refit: AP(full)-AP(without feature), plus descriptive standardized LR coefficients and RF/XGB native importances; not causal importance or conditional permutation
permutation_importance: not used in completion; explicitly disclosed method change from source proposal to avoid unrealistic independent row perturbations; drop-column and native importances answer original relative-importance RQ with narrower interpretation
inspection_tie_rule: stable observation order within ties; ceil(n*0.1)
uncertainty: paired percentile bootstrap of test predictions, independently resampling package clusters and project clusters; not simultaneous multiway correction and not training variability
multiplicity: descriptive exploratory intervals only; no significance-count claim or unadjusted confirmatory testing
training: origins strictly before test and training window_end <= test origin; availability audit reported separately
tuning: none; fixed parameters; no outcome-dependent selection
